priorities.summary: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit contains a missing-authentication flaw that lets a remote attacker access the toolkit without logging in, potentially leading to code execution, privilege escalation, data tampering, denial of service and information disclosure. Fixed in NeMo Agent Toolkit 1.9.0.

Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by a code-injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; a low-privileged attacker could exploit it with no user interaction required. Fixed in Campaign Classic 7.4.4 build 9403 (APSB26-162).

Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by an OS command-injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; a low-privileged attacker could exploit it with no user interaction required. Fixed in Campaign Classic 7.4.4 build 9403 (APSB26-162).

model.name: Google Gemini 4 Carbon
model.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Carbon, announced October 28, is its strongest frontier model yet, built for long-horizon engineering and cybersecurity defence: it ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (59) and leads SEC-bench Pro (88.2%), ExploitGym (54.8%) and CWE-bench (71.0%). It is rolling out first to a subset of cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program, at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens introductory pricing.
